7.7.17 Permanent DTCs (DM28)
The DM28 message reports OBD-relevant permanent DTCs.
[SWS_J1939Dcm_00074] ⌈On reception of request for DM28 (call of J1939Dcm_-
RequestIndication with parameter requestedPgn set according to table column
“PGN (Hexadecimal)” in [SWS_J1939Dcm_00238]) the J1939 Diagnostic Com-
munication Manager shall use the common “DTC status” sequence with the pa-
rameters DTCStatusFilter and DTCKind set according to the corresponding table
columns in [SWS_J1939Dcm_00236].⌋()
The common “DTC status” sequence is described in subsection 7.6.1.
[SWS_J1939Dcm_00075] ⌈The return values J1939DTC and OccurenceCounter
shall be encoded into the DM28 layout according to SAE J1939-73.⌋()
